dedupe_keys.name: agder and innlandet historic building climate and natural hazard indices

description: This Zenodo release assigns mapped hazard and climate-decay indicators to individual historic buildings in Agder and Innlandet, southern Norway. The Data in Brief article describes one building point per shapefile row with cadastral identifiers, cultural-heritage registry flags, five binary exposures to flood, rockfall, landslide, snow avalanche and overgrowth, and decay indices under a 1971–2000 baseline and two later climate periods through 2100. The producer lists separate county shapefiles with twenty-one columns under CC BY 4.0. This is a relative risk-screening dataset for registered or potentially historic buildings, not engineering-level fragility functions or a forecast that a particular building will fail. Hazard-map resolution, registry completeness, simplified exposure flags and future climate assumptions are limitations. A reviewer-assessed use is prioritising heritage assets for climate-adaptation scenarios. data-rescult-european-interoperable-database-cultural-heritage is a related heritage inventory, but no building identity crosswalk was tested. The article contains an upload-style Zenodo link; the canonical public record was opened. No shapefile was downloaded.
